en: The postcard shows a black and white (sepia-toned) panoramic view of a small European town with a body of water (pond or small lake) in the foreground. The background features a cluster of buildings, with a large church or religious building with a prominent tower dominating the skyline. Trees and greenery are plentiful throughout the scene. The town's name, 'Dippoldiswalde,' appears in red text at the bottom left, and there is additional publisher information in small red text at the lower margin.
